summary: Documented the report shell and directional briefs for the remaining supporting screens without prescribing unagreed content.

artifacts.description: Report and supporting screen design direction.

acceptance.criterion: The report brief names only the currently agreed example categories and marks detailed report content as pending.
acceptance.evidence: It gives example categories such as building age and earthquake/ground context, and delegates field-level report content.

acceptance.criterion: Saved, history, comparison, profile, settings, onboarding, help, and plans screens have clear purpose and design freedom boundaries.
acceptance.evidence: Each screen has its purpose and states the boundaries within which frontend can propose its own design.

acceptance.criterion: The brief preserves product safety language and does not invent scoring or listing behavior.
acceptance.evidence: The report rules explicitly prohibit safe/risk-free claims and invented scores or listing behavior.

checks.name: documentation whitespace check
checks.evidence: git diff --check completed successfully with no output.

risks: Detailed report categories, scoring, sources, and methodology remain pending product and data decisions.
followUps: Refine the report after the user provides its detailed content requirements.
